name: Bethany Anderson
headline: Understanding people. Understanding systems.
intro: Exploring the intersections of human behavior, research, policy, and social change.
bio:
I’m an undergraduate student at Washington University in St. Louis (Class of 2029), double majoring in Psychological & Brain Sciences and Political Science, with a minor in Drama.

I’m involved in research, community outreach, and education. With a focus on nonprofit work, my strong interest in mental health, equity, and public policy allows me to pursue leadership roles in service-based organizations. I hope to translate my academic knowledge into real-world impact, especially for marginalized communities.

Additionally, I participate in the performing arts!
